item.title: Shocked Face Gaming Thumbnail

turns.text: Make me a 16:9 YouTube thumbnail for a gaming challenge. Big shocked face on the right, the three words “ONE LAST TRY” on the left. Invent the person. Bright and punchy.

item.tests: Tests composing a generated face and exact three-word typography into one readable widescreen thumbnail.

answer_sheet.Person and expression: An invented person with a shocked expression; other details are your call.
answer_sheet.Headline: ONE LAST TRY
answer_sheet.Platform, size and layout: YouTube thumbnail, 16:9; face on the right and text on the left. Free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Style and background: Bright, punchy gaming style; specific colours and background are your call.

must_haves: A large, clearly visible human face on the right with a shocked expression.
The headline reads exactly “ONE LAST TRY”, with no additional words.
The headline sits on the left, is high-contrast and does not cover the face.

turns.text: Make me a bright, punchy 16:9 YouTube thumbnail for a gaming challenge, with a big shocked face on the right and the three words “ONE LAST TRY” on the left. Invent the person. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
The cheapest option is **one 16:9 image at 640px using Flux Schnell, starting at 5 Magic Hour credits**. It’s free-plan compatible; I haven’t started anything or spent credits.

I’d make:
- A bright, high-contrast gaming background with electric yellow and cyan accents.
- A large, invented person’s shocked face on the **right**.
- **“ONE LAST TRY”** in huge, bold lettering on the **left**, with a thick outline for readability.

**Ways to keep costs down**
- Generate **one image only**, with no automatic retries or upscaling.
- Use **640px**, the smallest available setting. This is below YouTube’s recommended 1280×720 thumbnail size.
- “Shorter” won’t save credits—it’s a still image, not a video.
- **Zero-credit alternative:** I can give you a prompt and layout to use yourself without running a generation.

The listed price starts at 5 credits; I can’t verify a live quote or your balance with the available tools. AI-generated lettering can also need correction, which could mean another paid run.

**Would you like one attempt, with a strict 5-credit limit and no retries?**

turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the attempt because your account has **insufficient credits**. No thumbnail was generated, and no generation credits were spent. I won’t retry.

The cheapest option we identified starts at **5 credits for one 640px image**. For a zero-credit alternative, you can use this prompt in another image tool:

> Bright, punchy 16:9 gaming challenge thumbnail. On the right, a huge close-up of an invented adult gamer with wide eyes, an open-mouthed shocked expression, and a cyan headset. On the left, enormous bold text reading exactly “ONE LAST TRY,” stacked in three lines, in white and yellow with thick black outlines. Electric yellow and cyan background, magenta accents, dramatic energy streaks, strong contrast, uncluttered composition. No other text or logos.
